```{r, message=FALSE}
# Library Import
library(dplyr)
library(biomaRt)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

setwd("~/Desktop/Tese/R/Transcriptomic analysis")
```


# 1. Data Import

```{r import, message=FALSE}

# Check files found
ipsc_files <- list.files("GSE280017_RAW",
                          pattern = "\\.isoforms\\.results\\.gz$",
                          full.names = TRUE)

ec_files <- list.files("GSE271456_RAW",
                        pattern = "\\.isoforms\\.results\\.gz$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

cat("iPSC files found:", length(ipsc_files), "\n")
cat("EC files found:",   length(ec_files),   "\n")

# Define sample names
all_files <- c(ipsc_files, ec_files)
all_names <- c(paste0("iPSC_", 1:10), paste0("EC_", 1:10))

# Load each file, aggregate TPM to gene level
sample_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(all_files)) {
  cat("Loading:", all_names[i], "\n")
  
  df <- read.table(all_files[i], header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
  
  df_agg <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, TPM) %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>%
    summarise(TPM = sum(TPM), .groups = "drop")
  
  colnames(df_agg)[2] <- all_names[i]
  
  sample_list[[i]] <- df_agg
}

# Join all samples on gene_id
tpm_joined <- sample_list[[1]]

for (i in 2:length(sample_list)) {
  tpm_joined <- full_join(tpm_joined, sample_list[[i]], by = "gene_id")
}

# Convert to matrix - correctly preserving rownames
tpm_matrix <- as.matrix(tpm_joined[, -1])
rownames(tpm_matrix) <- tpm_joined$gene_id
tpm_matrix[is.na(tpm_matrix)] <- 0

# Confirm
head(rownames(tpm_matrix))
dim(tpm_matrix)
```

# 2. Ensembl ID to HGNC Symbol Conversion

```{r biomart, message=FALSE}

# Clean Ensembl IDs - remove version suffix (e.g. ENSG00000000003.14_2 -> ENSG00000000003)
ensembl_ids_raw <- rownames(tpm_matrix)
ensembl_ids_clean <- sub("\\..*", "", ensembl_ids_raw)

# Retrieve HGNC symbols for all Ensembl IDs
# The mapping is saved to a file the first time, so later knits do not depend on Ensembl
map_file <- "~/Desktop/Tese/R/Transcriptomic analysis/ensembl_map_gse271456_gse280017.rds"

if (file.exists(map_file)) {
  gene_map <- readRDS(map_file)
} else {
  # Same BioMart query as getBM (ensembl_gene_id + hgnc_symbol, unique rows),
  # sent as GET because POST requests from biomaRt returned HTTP 405
  query_xml <- paste0(
    '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE Query>',
    '<Query virtualSchemaName="default" formatter="TSV" header="1" uniqueRows="1">',
    '<Dataset name="hsapiens_gene_ensembl" interface="default">',
    '<Attribute name="ensembl_gene_id"/><Attribute name="hgnc_symbol"/>',
    '</Dataset></Query>'
  )
  url <- paste0("https://www.ensembl.org/biomart/martservice?query=",
                utils::URLencode(query_xml, reserved = TRUE))
  res <- curl::curl_fetch_memory(url)
  full_map <- read.delim(text = rawToChar(res$content), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(full_map) <- c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol")
  full_map$hgnc_symbol[is.na(full_map$hgnc_symbol)] <- ""

  # Keep only the IDs present in this dataset (as getBM with a filter would return)
  gene_map <- full_map[full_map$ensembl_gene_id %in% ensembl_ids_clean, ]
  saveRDS(gene_map, map_file)
}

# Remove entries with empty HGNC symbol
gene_map <- gene_map[gene_map$hgnc_symbol != "", ]

# Match clean IDs back to original rownames
id_df <- data.frame(
  ensembl_clean = ensembl_ids_clean,
  original = ensembl_ids_raw,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
id_df <- left_join(id_df, gene_map, by = c("ensembl_clean" = "ensembl_gene_id"))

# Keep only rows with valid HGNC symbol
id_df <- id_df[!is.na(id_df$hgnc_symbol) & id_df$hgnc_symbol != "", ]

# Subset matrix and rename rows
tpm_hgnc <- tpm_matrix[id_df$original, ]
rownames(tpm_hgnc) <- id_df$hgnc_symbol

# Remove duplicate gene symbols - keep highest mean expression
tpm_hgnc <- tpm_hgnc[order(rowMeans(tpm_hgnc), decreasing = TRUE), ]
tpm_hgnc <- tpm_hgnc[!duplicated(rownames(tpm_hgnc)), ]

# Confirm
dim(tpm_hgnc)
head(rownames(tpm_hgnc))
```

# 3. Filtration

```{r filtration}

# Define group labels
group_labels_gse <- c(rep("iPSC", 10), rep("EC", 10))

# Define metadata
metadata_gse <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(tpm_hgnc),
  group  = group_labels_gse
)

# Require TPM > 1 in at least 50% of samples within at least one group
min_present <- function(n) ceiling(n * 0.5)

groups <- unique(metadata_gse$group)

keep_by_group <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  cols_g <- metadata_gse$sample[metadata_gse$group == g]
  n_g    <- length(cols_g)
  rowSums(tpm_hgnc[, cols_g, drop = FALSE] > 1) >= min_present(n_g)
})

keep         <- Reduce(`|`, keep_by_group)
tpm_filtered <- tpm_hgnc[keep, ]

# Confirm
dim(tpm_filtered)
```

# 4. Transformation

```{r Transformation}

# LOG2 TRANSFORMATION 
expr_log_gse271456 <- log2(tpm_filtered + 1)

# CANONICAL MARKER CHECK - Full canonical panel
pluripotency         <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC")
mesoderm_induction   <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34")
endothelial_identity <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

canonical_genes <- c(pluripotency, mesoderm_induction, endothelial_identity)

# Genes absent from dataset entirely
genes_not_in_data <- canonical_genes[!canonical_genes %in% rownames(tpm_hgnc)]

# Genes removed by filtration
genes_filtered_out <- canonical_genes[canonical_genes %in% rownames(tpm_hgnc) &
                                      !canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse271456)]

# Genes available for analysis
genes_use_gse271456 <- canonical_genes[canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse271456)]

cat("=== CANONICAL MARKER CHECK ===\n")
cat("Used in analysis:      ", paste(genes_use_gse271456,          collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Absent from dataset:   ", paste(genes_not_in_data,  collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Removed by filtration: ", paste(genes_filtered_out, collapse = ", "), "\n")

```
# 5. PCA 
```{r PCA}

# Prepare data matrix for PCA
dfforpca_gse <- t(expr_log_gse271456)
dfforpca_gse <- as.data.frame(dfforpca_gse)
dfforpca_gse$group_labels <- group_labels_gse

# Specify factor levels in trajectory order
dfforpca_gse$group_labels <- factor(dfforpca_gse$group_labels,
                                     levels = c("iPSC", "EC"))

# Run PCA
numcol_gse  <- 1:(ncol(dfforpca_gse) - 1)
pca_res_gse <- prcomp(dfforpca_gse[, numcol_gse], scale = FALSE)

# PCA plot
p_gse <- autoplot(
  pca_res_gse,
  data   = dfforpca_gse,
  x      = 1,
  y      = 2,
  colour = "group_labels",
  size   = 8,
  alpha  = 0.7
) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = "Cell Type",
    values = c("iPSC" = "lightblue",
               "EC"   = "lightgreen")
  ) +
  ggtitle("PCA Plot - GSE271456/GSE280017") +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  )

p_gse

# Top contributing genes per PC
contribs1_gse <- pca_res_gse$rotation[, 1]
contribs2_gse <- pca_res_gse$rotation[, 2]

(pos1genes_gse <- sort(contribs1_gse, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg1genes_gse <- sort(contribs1_gse, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])
(pos2genes_gse <- sort(contribs2_gse, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg2genes_gse <- sort(contribs2_gse, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])
```

# 6. Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=6.5}

# Create stage mapping
stage_map_gse271456 <- c(
  setNames(rep("Pluripotency",         length(pluripotency)),         pluripotency),
  setNames(rep("Mesoderm induction",   length(mesoderm_induction)),   mesoderm_induction),
  setNames(rep("Endothelial identity", length(endothelial_identity)), endothelial_identity)
)

row_stage_gse271456 <- factor(
  stage_map_gse271456[genes_use_gse271456],
  levels = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity")
)

# Subset and row-scale expression matrix
mat <- as.matrix(expr_log_gse271456[genes_use_gse271456, , drop = FALSE])
mat_z_gse271456 <- t(scale(t(mat)))
mat_z_gse271456[is.na(mat_z_gse271456)] <- 0

# Column groups
col_group_gse271456 <- factor(
  c(rep("iPSC", 10), rep("EC", 10)),
  levels = c("iPSC", "EC")
)

# Heatmap colour scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

# Top annotation
top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = anno_block(
    gp        = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels    = c("iPSC", "EC"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold", col = "black")
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  height = unit(7, "mm")
)

# Left annotation
left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Stage = anno_block(
    gp         = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels     = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity"),
    labels_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold", col = "black"),
    labels_rot = 0
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  width = unit(37, "mm")
)

# Draw heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_z_gse271456,
  name = "Z-score\nexpression",
  col  = col_fun,

  cluster_rows    = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  row_split    = row_stage_gse271456,
  column_split = col_group_gse271456,

  top_annotation  = top_ha,
  left_annotation = left_ha,

  column_title = NULL,
  row_title    = NULL,

  show_row_names    = TRUE,
  row_names_side    = "right",
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 10),

  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot  = 90,
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10),

  show_row_dend    = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,

  row_gap    = unit(3, "mm"),
  column_gap = unit(3, "mm"),

  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.6),
  border  = TRUE,

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title  = "Z-score\nexpression",
    at     = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
    labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2")
  )
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title        = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC and EC stages - GSE271456/GSE280017",
  column_title_side   = "top",
  column_title_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding             = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 20), "mm")
)
```
# 7. Export
```{r export}
library(writexl)

# Define full canonical panel for export
canonical_genes <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC",
                     "TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34",
                     "PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

# Create output directory
dir.create("results/GSE271456_GSE280017", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Gene availability table
gene_availability <- data.frame(
  gene          = canonical_genes,
  in_dataset    = canonical_genes %in% rownames(tpm_hgnc),
  after_filter  = canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse271456),
  status        = ifelse(
    !canonical_genes %in% rownames(tpm_hgnc), "Absent from dataset",
    ifelse(!canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse271456), "Removed by filtration", "Used")
  )
)

write.csv(gene_availability,
          "results/GSE271456_GSE280017/gene_availability.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# 2. PCA plot
pdf("results/GSE271456_GSE280017/pca_plot.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
print(p_gse)
dev.off()

# 3. Heatmap
pdf("results/GSE271456_GSE280017/heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 6.5)
draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title        = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC and EC stages - GSE271456/GSE280017",
  column_title_side   = "top",
  column_title_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding             = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 20), "mm")
)
dev.off()

write.csv(mat_z_gse271456, "results/GSE271456_GSE280017/mat_z.csv")
```
